# Temporal

> Temporal is a privacy-focused, local-first personal finance app for Android. It combines a double-entry ledger, investment portfolio tracking (stocks, mutual funds, gold, fixed deposits), and an on-device AI pipeline (Gemma LLM via LiteRT) that parses bank statements and receipts entirely on-device. Financial data never touches Temporal's servers.

## Product

- One-time purchase (₹49), no subscription, no account required.
- Works fully offline; cloud AI providers are strictly opt-in with the user's own API key.
- Data storage: local SQLite on the user's device only.

## Key Facts

- Platform: Android
- Pricing model: one-time lifetime license, zero recurring fees
- AI: on-device inference by default (LiteRT + Gemma); optional user-keyed cloud providers
- Backup/restore: encrypted data export ("Recovery Kit")
